description: Generate compelling visual insights into Bitcoin accumulation strategy and holdings with focus on personal 'orange plot' (Saylor-style) showing purchases against BTC-USD price history
principles: Bitcoin-first focus - all visualizations centered on BTC
Data-driven insights - every chart tells a clear story about your stack
Use existing query infrastructure - no new database queries needed
Simple PNG outputs - easy to share, embed in reports, post to social media
Smart defaults with configurability - works out of box, customizable for power users
Comprehensive test coverage - all chart generation logic tested

testingRequirements.coverage: Minimum 85% line coverage for visualization code
testingRequirements.unitTests: Test data transformation and calculation logic
testingRequirements.integrationTests: Test chart generation with sample data (verify files created)
testingRequirements.edgeCases: Empty ledger, single transaction, missing price data, future dates
testingRequirements.visualRegression: Manual review of generated PNGs (automated pixel-diff testing optional)

fileStructure.description: New visualization package lives in src/python/viz/ package

src/python/viz/.config.py: VizConfig dataclass: date ranges, output paths, chart styling
src/python/viz/.data_fetcher.py: PriceDataFetcher class: fetch BTC-USD from yfinance, cache locally
src/python/viz/.orange_plot.py: OrangePlot class: generate Saylor-style purchase visualization
src/python/viz/.balance_chart.py: BalanceChart class: BTC balance growth over time
src/python/viz/.custody_chart.py: CustodyChart class: stacked area chart by custody type
src/python/viz/.report.py: OPTIONAL (VIZ-006): PDF report generator combining all charts

src/scripts/.btc_viz: NEW - CLI script to generate visualizations

tests/.test_viz_data.py: NEW - test data fetching and transformation

fixtures/.sample_btc_prices.json: Cached BTC-USD prices for offline tests

output/.viz/: Default output directory for generated charts (in .gitignore)

priceDataSource.decision: Use yfinance library for BTC-USD historical prices
priceDataSource.rationale: Free, reliable, widely used. User confirmed yfinance works for BTC-USD from separate effort.
priceDataSource.caching: Cache fetched price data locally to avoid repeated API calls

dateRanges.decision: Configurable date ranges with smart presets

presets.ytd: Year-to-date (Jan 1 of current year to today)

dateRanges.custom: Support --start-date and --end-date flags for custom ranges

orangePlot.buyMarkers: Large orange dots (size proportional to BTC amount)
orangePlot.title: Personal Orange Plot - Bitcoin Accumulation Strategy

balanceChart.line: Orange line showing cumulative BTC balance
balanceChart.title: Bitcoin Balance Growth Over Time

custodyChart.areas: Stacked areas by custody type (self-custodied on bottom, custodial on top)
custodyChart.title: Bitcoin Holdings by Custody Type

costBasisOverlay.decision: Include cost basis line on orange plot using existing TradeQuery

implementation.algorithm: Calculate running weighted average at each purchase
implementation.formula: Running Basis = (Cumulative USD Invested) / (Cumulative BTC Acquired)
pseudocode: purchases = [t for t in trades if t['quantity'] > 0 and t['unit_cost'] is not None]
edgeCases: Skip purchases with unit_cost = None (missing price data)
Handle first purchase (division by zero prevention)

costBasisOverlay.display: Dashed blue line showing USD invested per BTC over time
costBasisOverlay.note: Shows how cost basis evolved - interesting for DCA through market cycles

dataQueries.decision: Leverage existing query classes - no new database queries

sources.custody: Join ledger with wallets table on exchange = wallet_id

errorHandling.missingPriceData: Warn user, generate chart with available data
errorHandling.emptyLedger: Show friendly message: 'No Bitcoin transactions found. Start stacking!'
errorHandling.apiFailure: Fall back to cached data if available, clear error message otherwise
errorHandling.invalidDateRange: Validate start < end, dates not in future

userStories.title: Visualization infrastructure and price data fetching
acceptanceCriteria: - date_range: str (preset) or tuple of dates
- Uses yfinance to fetch BTC-USD ticker data
- Returns DataFrame with columns: date, open, high, low, close, volume
- Only re-fetches data for dates not in cache
- Handles API failures gracefully with clear error messages
Unit tests: PriceDataFetcher with mocked yfinance
Unit tests: Error handling for API failures
userStories.notes: Foundation for all visualizations. yfinance is well-established library.

userStories.title: Orange Plot - Personal Bitcoin accumulation visualization
acceptanceCriteria: - Fetch BTC-USD price history for date range
- Get BTC trade costs from TradeQuery.get_trade_cost('BTC', 'USD')
- Plot BTC-USD price as orange line
- Overlay purchases as large orange scatter points (size = BTC amount * scale_factor)
- Overlay sales as green scatter points
- Optional: Add cost basis line using running calculation (see costBasisOverlay in keyDecisions):
- Calculate running weighted average: cumulative_cost / cumulative_btc
- Plot as dashed blue line showing basis evolution over time
- Add grid, legend, title, axis labels
Annotation: Show total BTC purchased, total USD invested on chart
Edge case: Handle empty ledger (no transactions)
Edge case: Handle missing price data for some dates
Unit tests: Data transformation logic (trades to scatter points)
Integration test: Generate chart with sample data, verify file created
userStories.notes: This is the star feature! Emotional impact. Like Saylor's Strategy plot.

userStories.title: Balance growth chart - BTC stack over time
acceptanceCriteria: - Get all BTC transactions ordered by date
- Calculate cumulative balance at each transaction date
- Plot balance as orange line chart
- Fill area under curve with light orange
- Add milestone markers (e.g., 0.1 BTC, 1 BTC, 10 BTC)
- Show current balance in title or annotation
- Add grid, legend, title, axis labels
Edge case: Single transaction (show as single point + projection)
Edge case: Balance goes negative (shouldn't happen, but show warning)
Integration test: Generate chart, verify file exists
userStories.notes: Simple but powerful - shows your stack growth at a glance.

userStories.title: Custody breakdown - Stacked area chart by wallet type
acceptanceCriteria: - Query ledger JOIN wallets on exchange = wallet_id
- Group BTC balance by custody type (self-custodied, custodial, multisig) over time
- Add legend showing current balance per custody type
- Add annotations for major custody transitions
Edge case: Transactions with no wallet metadata (unknown custody = gray)
Edge case: All in one custody type (show single area, not stack)
Unit tests: Balance grouping by custody type
Integration test: Generate chart with mixed custody transactions

userStories.title: CLI script and documentation
acceptanceCriteria: Script imports _bootstrap (for db and viz packages)
Instantiate appropriate chart classes based on --chart flag

userStories.title: OPTIONAL: PDF report generation combining all charts
acceptanceCriteria: - Cover page: Title, date range, summary stats
